projects.title: MyCampus - Campus Utility App
projects.details:
React Native, Firebase, Expo
• Created a full-stack campus utility mobile application for IIITN students integrating mess menu, academic calendar, discussion forums, timetable management, attendance tracking, and club updates.
• Integrated Firebase authentication and real-time database to manage user accounts, attendance records, and dynamic content updates.
• Deployed the application within the institute community and onboarded 250+ active users, iterating features based on continuous feedback.

projects.title: AI PPT Generator – Multi-Agent Presentation Builder
projects.details:
Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, Next.js
• Built an AI-powered presentation generator using a multi-agent architecture that converts natural language prompts into structured PowerPoint slides with automated research, planning, and content generation.
• Designed a LangGraph-based workflow with specialized agents (Prompt Parser, Research Agent, Slide Planner, Content Writer, Designer, and Compiler) to orchestrate the end-to-end PPT generation pipeline.
• Developed a FastAPI backend to process user prompts, coordinate agent execution, and dynamically generate PowerPoint files using python-pptx.
• Implemented a Next.js frontend with authentication and an interactive UI allowing users to generate, preview, and download AI-generated presentations.

projects.title: Travel Mate Matching Platform
projects.details:
React, FastAPI, MongoDB, LLM-based Extraction
• Built a travel companion matching platform that extracts structured travel details from uploaded tickets using an LLM-based extraction pipeline.
• Designed backend matching logic in FastAPI to identify compatible travel partners based on source, destination, travel date, and timing similarity.
• Integrated MongoDB Atlas for persistent ticket storage, duplicate detection, and efficient search across travel records.
• Created a React interface enabling ticket upload, local data persistence, and real-time display of ranked travel matches.
